$comment: template_version: 0.2.0. Registry v1 (#3): per-hop declarations of slide:p06-narrow-downstream (downstream never wider than upstream): aud, scope, lifetime, organization claims, exchanger. Checked by L16 of #6.
title: Hops v1

upstream.description: Hop whose token this hop narrows (for exchange / reissue / service)

token_type.description: Token type of token_types.yaml on this hop, null when no token travels (a DB connection)

aud.description: aud of the token on this hop (resource indicator, RFC 8707). Downstream does not widen it

scope.description: scope on this hop. Downstream does not widen it

max_lifetime.description: Seconds; lifetime of the token on this hop (null when no token). Downstream does not exceed upstream unless narrowing_exception says why (a Txn-Token MAY outlive the presented token, draft-ietf-oauth-transaction-tokens-11 §6)

custom_claims.description: Registry rows of organization claims carried on this hop (or the values copied, for a DB hop)

authorization_details.description: authorization_details types carried on this hop, narrowed to its audience (RFC 9396 §9.1)

exchanger.description: Service that exchanges or reissues the token for this hop (null when the token is passed as is)
exchanger.$comment: Trace: req:p06-narrow-downstream.R2 req:p02-delegation-client.R3 req:p03-absorb-idp-differences.R1 req:p04-reject-missing-required.R3 req:p04-single-issuer.R4 req:p10-token-exchange-not-narrowing.R2

validates.description: What the receiver of the hop checks and whether it validates locally (accepted until exp) or asks the issuer

connection_max_lifetime.description: Seconds; lifetime of a DB / broker connection on this hop, compared with the token lifetime (slide:p07-lifetime-mismatch)

forwarded_headers.description: Claims copied into headers on this hop (L8: inbound headers of the same name are dropped)

narrowing_exception.description: Why this hop is allowed to go beyond its upstream. A string is the reason for max_lifetime (a Txn-Token may outlive the original token, draft-ietf-oauth-transaction-tokens-11 §6). An object gives a reason per dimension (aud, scope, max_lifetime, authorization_details); L16 then reports info with the reason. Extra custom_claims have no exception

aud_replacement.description: An exchange or reissue hop that replaces aud with a single different audience (narrowing by replacement, slide:p06-narrow-downstream). Needs one aud and narrowing_exception.aud (L16)
